subject: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic

Hi Sarah / Tom 

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery:

Call recap:
- Primary workload: chat assistant + summarization for support tickets.
- Current estimate: 200-300M tokens/month (peak season up to ~400M).
- Key must-haves: predictable unit economics (target $/1M tokens), dedicated capacity options, SOC2 evidence and audit logs.

Budget and target pricing discussed on call:
- ACME stated target price around $75 / 1M tokens with a stretch range $50-120 / 1M depending on SLA/commitment.
- For comparison and benchmarking we discussed the following rough public / market numbers (for a like-for-like text-generation mix):
  - OpenAI (API managed): ~ $100-130 / 1M tokens (varies by model & context length).
  - Anthropic (API managed): ~ $90-120 / 1M tokens depending on model/throughput.
  - Open-model hosts / self-hosted + managed infra: ~$30-80 / 1M tokens (lower unit costs but ops + reliability delta).
  - Redwood target competitive price: we typically aim to be 20-40% below the managed incumbents at scale with committed pricing and batching/kv-cache effects - realistic target pricing bands depend on committed volumes.

What we need from ACME to get a formal benchmark and proposal:
1) Confirm monthly token ranges (min/nominal/peak).
2) Confirm preferred pricing model: committed monthly + overage vs fully usage-based.
3) Any requirements for retention, private deployment, or dedicated tenancy that affect unit economics.

Attachments: I attached a short pricing-sheet + the token-usage template for your team to confirm numbers.

Next steps / proposed timeline:
- ACME: return the filled usage spreadsheet (attached) by EOD Mon (10/26).
- Redwood: Marissa will prepare a target-price benchmarking slide deck (Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic/hosted self-hosted) and two pricing options (committed reserved vs usage-based).
- Follow-up call: suggest Wed 10/28 to review benchmarking + proposed commercial.

Thanks - this felt like a great fit to move to a scoped PoC and committed-tier pricing if numbers align.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

--
Attachments:
- 20261020-acme-pricing-sheet.pdf (pricing worksheet)
- acme-token-usage.csv (template)

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic

Thanks Vanessa - great recap. A couple clarifications and answers from our side: 

- Confirmed monthly baseline: 250M tokens/month nominal; expected trough ~120M and peak ~420M.
- Target price: our procurement target is $75 / 1M tokens; we can stretch to $50-120 depending on SLA, data isolation, and committed term.
- Preferred pricing model: committed monthly with overage is preferable for budgeting, but open to a blended usage model for the PoC.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + KMS integration required before formal procurement sign-off.

I'll fill and return the token usage spreadsheet by Monday. Please include a row showing unit economics for the committed option at 250M, 350M, and 420M tiers (we want per-token cost and estimated monthly bill). Also include the comparable numbers (OpenAI/Anthropic/public hosts) in the deck.

Thanks - happy to take the 10/28 slot if you send a calendar invite.

- Sarah Jenkins
Director, Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
sarah.jenkins@acme.com

Marissa / Rachel - forwarding Sarah's response. Action items:

Marissa:
- Please prepare a benchmarking slide (1-2 slides) with the requested unit economics rows: 250M, 350M, 420M. Show the per-1M token price and projected monthly bill. Include side-by-side comparisons: Redwood committed vs Redwood usage-based vs OpenAI vs Anthropic vs generic open-model hosted. I highlighted our target band $50-75 as the commercial ask.
- Also produce 2 commercial options: 12-month committed reserve and 3-month PoC blended usage.
- Pull in SOC2 + KMS integration notes (we'll need to surface the compliance timeline).

Rachel:
- Can you model the rough impact of KV-prefix caching and batching on per-token cost assumptions for the 250-420M bands? Callout assumptions so sales/legal can reference.

I'll draft the invite for 10/28 and loop in legal/solutions if needed.

Thanks - Vanessa
